walk.summary:
Row R walked in Chromium against an ENCRYPTED store. It was locked at boot and unlocked through the real #pw form, and stayed in airplane mode with zero egress. Two consent popups were opened, read, screenshotted and cancelled with 'Stay offline'. All five ooMap surfaces were REACHED WITH DATA, every measurement scoped to its own host: World map, Sources coverage, Governments → Map, Governments → Statistics and Super-groups ring map. My extra seed made that possible: synthetic World Bank figures for 229 countries through the app's own parse_worldbank + store_figures, plus six election-ring articles from sources located in dispute-claimant countries through the real index_article.

What passes on all five surfaces, in en/fr/ar/zh at 1440 and en at 375:
- Equal Earth: viewBox 0 0 720 350.44, rendered aspect 2.0547, curved meridians, sphere outline.
- Natural Earth 50m: 229 country paths.
- 28 contested areas, hatched in every worldview.
- 'Equal Earth · equal-area' named and translated in the legend.
- The contested caveat is visible, not behind a toggle.
- A 34-option worldview picker, sorted by localised name, defaulting to 'contested' with 0 areas attributed.
- Switching worldview really re-attributes areas (India 27, China 28, ISO 25, Russia 24, Ukraine 26, Pakistan 27) and returns to 0 on 'contested'. Tooltips follow ('attributed to Morocco / Russia / Ukraine / Pakistan').
- No page, console or HTTP >= 400 errors.
- tests/test_countries_geo.py: 13 passed, in both the main repo and the build tree.

The row still does NOT clear its bar. Two P2 defects:
1. Every contested tooltip leads with the ENGLISH area name in fr/ar/zh ('Crimean Peninsula — متنازع عليها: روسيا / أوكرانيا'), because app-map.js:388 reads OOI18N.lang, which does not exist. The ×12 names in world_disputed.json are never used.
2. Three of 28 areas name only ONE claimant: Abyei 'Sudan', Tigri Area 'Guyana', Lawa Headwaters 'France'. South Sudan and Suriname have no Natural Earth point-of-view column, and the count test's non-empty check passes on it.

P3 findings:
- A worldview chosen on one map does not reach the Sources map, so two conventions are on screen at once. Its stamp guard (app-sources.js:43) ignores the worldview.
- The Statistics and ring maps keep the previous language after a switch until they are re-run.
- The ring map's method and caveat are server English, and the caveat shows the word 'null'.
- The Governments map legend unit 'years' is untranslated.
- The worldview select truncates 'Contested (assign nothing)' to 'Contested (assign r'.
- A 6 px horizontal overflow at 375 on the ring-map surface, caused by a non-wrapping concept chip.
- Contested claims cannot be reached by touch.
- The Q1150 'ooMap embed on When / Where' does not exist in this build: the analysis window's When/Where/Who is chips only, and the ledger records it as scoped, not built.

Known items were not re-reported: plural frames ('1 articles'), fmtNum formatting, the duplicate id="oo-choro", the in-map controls covering the World map at phone width (recorded 2026-09-16), and the 'contested' default (OSM's default is 0.5's).

Not measured: Insights → Map (cities), which is on its honest empty state because it needs a source city and the gazetteer, and is outside the task's five hosts; and native SVG tooltips, which headless Chromium does not draw. Hover text was read from the <title> of the element under the real pointer.

recheck.summary:
I re-checked row R on my own instance and all 23 items are confirmed: nothing was a harness artifact, nothing was by design, and nothing failed to reproduce. Only the native-tooltip half of the touch item could not be measured here.

**Setup.** App on port 9150 from the read-only tree at 0deff9c4 (git status clean before and after). Data dir `/tmp/claude-0/rewalk/R-recheck/data`, seeded with the standing encrypted seed plus my own seed, `/tmp/claude-0/rewalk/R-recheck/scripts/seed_recheck.py`, run with the app stopped and the store kept encrypted. It adds World Bank-shaped figures (through `parse_worldbank` and `store_figures`) for SP.DYN.LE00.IN and NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, 229 countries × 2020–2022, and five 'election'-ring articles located in ge, az, il, jp and ma (through `index_article` and `ensure_fts`).
- **At rest:** the file header is ciphertext before and after. lock-state read 'locked' at boot and 'unlocked-encrypted' after the real #pw / #btn-unlock form.
- **Network:** airplane mode throughout. No consent popup opened in my paths. The browser made 0 non-loopback requests and saw no page errors, console errors or HTTP responses >= 400. The only 503 in the server log is my own curl to /api/system/network while the store was still locked.
- **Server:** stopped by PID 3463 only; it shut down cleanly.

**All five surfaces reached with data** (en 1440, fr/ar/zh through #lang-switch, en 375 through #hamburger, plus a touch probe). Scoped to each host:
- viewBox 0 0 720 350.44; aspect 2.0547 at 1440 and 2.0546 at 375.
- 229 country paths, 28 contested areas, 12 of 13 meridians curved, sphere outline present.
- Legend 'Equal Earth · equal-area' in all four locales; the contested caveat is visible.
- Worldview picker has 34 options, default 'contested' with 0 areas attributed.
- Switching changes attribution and switching back restores it: in → 27, ua → 26, pk → 27.

**Governments → Map** shows its honest empty state first because NY.GDP.MKTP.CD was not seeded; with Life expectancy all 229 countries fill. **Count test:** `tests/test_countries_geo.py` gives 13 passed both in /home/user/Open-Omniscience (60aaf429) and in the build tree.

**Main root causes:**
1. `app-map.js:388` reads `OOI18N.lang`, which does not exist (i18n.js exports `current()`), so contested-area names are English in every locale.
2. `src/timemap/disputed_geo.py:163-170` builds claims only from Natural Earth's 33 viewpoints. South Sudan and Suriname are not among them, so Abyei, Tigri Area and Lawa Headwaters each name one claimant.
3. `app-sources.js:42` leaves the worldview out of the Sources map's repaint fingerprint. I reproduced it in the opposite order from the walker: Sources stayed on India after the World map went back to Contested.
4. `renderStatMap` and `showRingMap` are not in the `oo:langchange` listener (`app-boot.js:41-305`), so those two maps keep the previous locale; I saw a French legend in ar and an Arabic one in zh.
5. `app-insights.js:489` shows the ring map's server English method and caveat, including the word 'null' from `queries.py:1644`.
6. `app-gov-law.js:796` passes the unit 'years' untranslated.
7. `app-map.js:800` caps the worldview select at 150px, so the default label is cut off, including '(assign nothing)'.
8. At 375 px, a concept chip that cannot wrap (`app-insights.js:387-389`) makes the page 381 px wide.
9. Contested claims live only in an SVG `<title>`, which the #oo-tip long-press convention never marks (`app-boot.js:384`), so on touch they cannot be reached.
10. The analysis window's When/Where/Who has no ooMap embed. It was never built (shipped.csv:915, 'Scoped, not built'), so the row cites a surface that does not exist.

**Not measurable here:** whether a real mobile browser shows the SVG `<title>` natively; headless Chromium cannot tell.

Scripts are in `/tmp/claude-0/rewalk/R-recheck/scripts/` (`rlib.py`, `pass_en.py`, `pass_locales.py`, `pass_375.py`, `pass_touch.py`, `pass_analysis.py`).
